instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. Inside a boxing gym, the man with a braided mohawk and beard in a black t-shirt (R2) stands on the left in profile, facing right. He holds the forearm of the woman with braided hair in a black strapless top (R1) on the right with his tattooed right hand, guiding her boxing stance. She wears black boxing gloves and smiles slightly as she practices. In the blurred background, a single bystander in dark clothing is visible near a punching bag. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the training session, creating a neutral color palette.
